rationale: PP03 flagged three position-purity rows whose bundle evidence says their source period is earlier than the 2025-03-31 report_date. The raw source table of contents identifies a separate Consolidated Schedule of Investments as of December 31, 2024, and the cited culprit rows appear in that comparative-period schedule block rather than being March 31, 2025 current-period rows. Retaining those December 31, 2024 source rows in the March 31, 2025 holdings population is a real comparative-period leak.
